candidate_exposure.custody: Self-custodied. Claude (Opus 5.5, in Tim Hulshof's project) designed the method, prepares the inputs and will run the evaluation; no external custodian. Separation rests on recorded order: this method freeze (git commit + Claude project record), then panel A inputs (media, carbon sources, base models, adjudication packets and decisions) and an inputs freeze, then the first download of panel A fitness tables.
candidate_exposure.uninspected_evidence: No fitness table (fit_logratios, fit_t) of any panel A or panel B organism has been downloaded; the panel metadata manifest lists every file downloaded for them (experiment and gene metadata, protein sequences). Panel A condition names have not been read; only scripts printing counts, medium names and the aerobic flag have touched the experiment tables. Training exposure of the model to published phenotypes of these organisms is unknown.

plan.decision_rule: Supported if the mean difference is positive and the organism-bootstrap 95% interval excludes zero; not supported if the mean is zero or negative; inconclusive otherwise. Every organism and every arm is reported, including failures.

declared_values.carveme_universe_path: external/carveme/universe_bacteria.xml.gz (outside the freeze root; hash recorded here and in every base-model record)

plan.primary_metric: per-organism paired MCC difference on the union of both arms' scored genes (absent gene = no predicted effect), conditions where both wild types grow; aggregate = unweighted mean over evaluable organisms with a 10,000-resample organism bootstrap (seed 0); sign counts and exact sign test
plan.question: Do fitness-blind, annotation-driven corrections (U') and blind AI adjudication of gene rules (M) improve EMBL GEMs draft-model predictions of carbon-source gene fitness on six organisms not used in development?
plan.time_ordering_note: Frozen before any panel A input beyond gene/experiment metadata, protein sequences and gene maps was prepared, and before any panel fitness table was downloaded.

evaluation_caveat: File hashes record declared inputs, not evaluation independence. The five named development organisms are exposed. Other downloaded organisms have unknown prior exposure and remain quarantined pending independent evaluation. Documentary claims about prospective external evaluation require independent review.
